private_capability.writer: Module-private WeakMap in epoch, separate from existing public readers WeakMap. No exported writer.
private_capability.exported_resolver: Returns the registered original caller callback plus a reference-only private comparison translation and retained guards. Unknown callbacks pass through unchanged; never substitute a disk reader. Resolve nested brands with root checks. Never expose comparison bytes via public read/raw.

private_capability.late_semantics: Each association captures exact before/current reference pairs after the owner guard qualified them. Guard both sides at lookup and after use; reject changed metadata/current callbacks, wrong roots and cyclic associations.

separate_maps.metadata_bound: Retain every original byte comparison and hash against the exact private predecessor view, including OWNER=original BASE, original native registry and original registered checker. No original expected hash changes.
separate_maps.current_source_bound: Physical selection/title/native/current source scopes and all their current input refs. Their constructors receive only the explicitly resolved actual callback. Retain their original guards and merge actual refs into the outer prepared bound map only after preserving the private metadata guard closure.
separate_maps.selectionMember: Check physical bytes against actual qualified current ref; check any comparison bytes against the finite captured private ref translation; retain both bindings; return only the original private comparison bytes to the old literal-comparison caller. Unknown differing bytes fail.
separate_maps.historical_wrapper_calls: Use the actual physical titleReaders.withHistoricalToolMetadata with explicit comparisonRead:read for historicalChipWrapperMetadata and historicalConsumerWrapperMetadata. Do not construct another current checker from the historical callback.

mandatory_old_guards.required_successor: Authenticate old BASE bytes through Git + exact literal patch as comparison data, then bind actual new BASE bytes via the narrow reader-owner transition. Keep original packet/hash unchanged.
Preserve baseImage as the original authenticated BASE metadata image. Bind actual BASE separately; do not use new BASE source as old OWNER metadata.
The added BASE transition in historicalContractRepairReaderSubject qualifies the actual current file while comparisonBytes retains the exact old packet bytes.

All other prior rows deep-equal. Keep prior epoch after-image as an explicitly authenticated intermediate metadata reference.
